name: C10-0263/2025 – Commission proposal
title: Deforestation Regulation: certain obligations of operators and traders ***I
part_text:
1. The Council recommends that Belgium follow a seven-year plan to bring its public finances under control. Belgium's deficit is above the EU limit of 3% of GDP, and its debt is over 100% of GDP. The plan caps how fast public spending can grow and lists reforms to pensions, the labour market, taxes and budget coordination. In return, Belgium gets three extra years to fix its deficit instead of four.

- Spending growth is capped each year from 2025 to 2029, with average growth of 2.6%.
- It affects Belgium's government, workers, pensioners and companies facing tax and benefit changes.
- Belgium must pass the listed reforms by set deadlines; the Council and Commission will check progress.
